title: alternative — sharpen

phrases.translation: 没有别的办法了；没有其他选择
代用燃料；可替代燃料；人造液体燃料
v. 别无选择；只得；唯一的办法是
交替计划；可供选择的方案

sentences.sentence: If payment is not received legal action will be our only alternative .
sentences.translation: 如果收不到付款，我们只能采取法律行动。

sentences.sentence: I had no alternative but to report him to the police.
sentences.translation: 除了向警方举报他，我别无选择。

sentences.sentence: He quickly assessed what alternatives were open to him.
sentences.translation: 他迅速估计了一下还有哪些办法可以采用。

sentences.sentence: He specializes in archaeology.
sentences.translation: 他专修考古学。

sentences.sentence: Because of my studies in Near Eastern archaeology, I read up on the history of this region as of the 19th century — during the Ottoman Empire.
sentences.translation: 因为我对近东考古学的研究，所以我仔细研读了该地区的19世纪的历史---即奥斯曼帝国时代的历史。

sentences.sentence: "There was no access to clean water, there was no access to basic education especially in the rural areas where the archaeology was," she says.
sentences.translation: 在那里的考古学特别是农村地区，我们并没有获得干净的水，有没有基本的教育的机会，“她说。

translations.translation: 考古学的；与考古学有关的 (<美>archeological)

sentences.sentence: So there are two other models, then, models different from the immigration model, two other models for understanding the formation of Israel, that build on this archaeological evidence.
sentences.translation: 那么还有两个其他的模型，与移民模型不同的两个模型，这两个模型也是为了说明以色列的形成，它们是依据考古学证据。

sentences.sentence: In fact, she was an archaeologist.
sentences.translation: 其实她是一个考古学家。

sentences.sentence: But I do not believe, as a field archaeologist, that we can use the scientific method to prove or disprove [them].
sentences.translation: 但作为一个在现场工作的考古学家，我不相信我们能用科学手段对它们进行证实或证伪。

sentences.sentence: Somaliland's first archaeologist, Mire is now on a mission to preserve and protect what she says is a heritage at risk of disappearing.
sentences.translation: 作为索马里兰的第一个考古学家，沼泽湿地现在的任务是维持和保护她所说的具有消失危险的遗产。

sentences.sentence: If he thinks I’m particular about excavation records, you should see him taking pictures!

sentences.sentence: They were genetically distinct from other humans, and an upper molar tooth (above) found at the same excavation hints that these people were similar to earlier species like Homo erectus.

text:
英语词汇 · 人教高中 · 第 140 单元

alternative
音标：英 /ɔːl'tɜːnətɪv; ɒl-/  美 /ɔl'tɝnətɪv/
n. 可能的选择
adj. 供选择的；其他的
短语：alternative energy — 替代能源；新能源
短语：alternative medicine — 非传统医学
短语：have no alternative — 没有别的办法了；没有其他选择
短语：alternative fuel — 代用燃料；可替代燃料；人造液体燃料
短语：alternative method — 替代的方法
短语：alternative approach — 变换方法
短语：have no alternative but — v. 别无选择；只得；唯一的办法是
短语：alternative energy sources — 替代能源
短语：alternative investment — 另类投资
短语：alternative splicing — 可变剪接
短语：alternative solution — 可选择的解决方案
短语：alternative plan — 交替计划；可供选择的方案
短语：alternative design — 替代设计；比较设计
短语：alternative use — 选择使用；交替使用
短语：alternative option — 替代，替代物；比较选择方案
短语：alternative media — 另类媒介；另类媒体
短语：alternative form — 代替方式；替换制度
例句：If payment is not received legal action will be our only alternative .
如果收不到付款，我们只能采取法律行动。
例句：I had no alternative but to report him to the police.
除了向警方举报他，我别无选择。
例句：He quickly assessed what alternatives were open to him.
他迅速估计了一下还有哪些办法可以采用。

archaeology
音标：英 /,ɑːkɪ'ɒlədʒɪ/  美 /,ɑrkɪ'ɑlədʒi/
n. 考古学(<美>archeology)
例句：He specializes in archaeology.
他专修考古学。
例句：Because of my studies in Near Eastern archaeology, I read up on the history of this region as of the 19th century — during the Ottoman Empire.
因为我对近东考古学的研究，所以我仔细研读了该地区的19世纪的历史---即奥斯曼帝国时代的历史。
例句："There was no access to clean water, there was no access to basic education especially in the rural areas where the archaeology was," she says.
在那里的考古学特别是农村地区，我们并没有获得干净的水，有没有基本的教育的机会，“她说。

archaeological
adj. 考古学的；与考古学有关的 (<美>archeological)
短语：archaeological site — 考古遗址；遗迹
例句：So there are two other models, then, models different from the immigration model, two other models for understanding the formation of Israel, that build on this archaeological evidence.
那么还有两个其他的模型，与移民模型不同的两个模型，这两个模型也是为了说明以色列的形成，它们是依据考古学证据。

archaeologist
音标：英 /,ɑːkɪ'ɒlədʒɪst/  美 /,ɑrkɪ'ɑlədʒɪst/
n. 考古学家(<美>archeologist)
例句：In fact, she was an archaeologist.
其实她是一个考古学家。
例句：But I do not believe, as a field archaeologist, that we can use the scientific method to prove or disprove [them].
但作为一个在现场工作的考古学家，我不相信我们能用科学手段对它们进行证实或证伪。
例句：Somaliland's first archaeologist, Mire is now on a mission to preserve and protect what she says is a heritage at risk of disappearing.
作为索马里兰的第一个考古学家，沼泽湿地现在的任务是维持和保护她所说的具有消失危险的遗产。

starvation
音标：英 /stɑː'veɪʃn/  美 /stɑr'veʃən/
n. 挨饿；饿死
例句：people dying of starvation
快饿死的人们

tentative
音标：英 /'tentətɪv/  美 /'tɛntətɪv/
adj. 试探性的；不确定的
短语：tentative plan — 设想；试验性计划
短语：tentative data — 试验数据；推测数据
短语：tentative schedule — 试验性时间表
短语：tentative standard — 暂行标准
例句：I passed on my tentative conclusions to the police.
我把我的初步结论递交给了警方。
例句：The government is taking tentative steps towards tackling the country’s economic problems.
政府正在采取临时性措施来解决国家的经济问题。

accuracy
音标：英 /'ækjʊrəsɪ/  美 /'ækjərəsi/
n. 精确；准确
短语：high accuracy — 高准确度
短语：measurement accuracy — 量测精度
短语：measuring accuracy — 测量精度；计量精度
短语：machining accuracy — 加工精度；精加工精确度
短语：control accuracy — 控制精度
短语：positioning accuracy — 定位精度；定位准确度
短语：calculation accuracy — 计算精度
短语：tracking accuracy — 跟踪精度
短语：degree of accuracy — 精确度
短语：accuracy of measurement — 测量精度
短语：dimensional accuracy — 尺寸精度
短语：location accuracy — 定位精度；定位准确度
短语：accuracy control — 精度控制；精确控制，精确度控制
短语：accuracy test — 精度检验，精度试验；准确度测试
短语：calibration accuracy — 校准精度；校准精确度
短语：accuracy of measuring — 计量准确度
短语：dynamic accuracy — 动态精度；动态正确性；动态准确度
短语：alignment accuracy — 对准精度；调整精度
短语：relative accuracy — 相对精度
短语：accuracy grade — 精度等级；准确度级别
例句：He passes the ball with unerring accuracy.
他传球准确无误。

excavate
音标：英 /'ekskəveɪt/  美 /'ɛkskə'vet/
v. 挖掘；发掘
例句：Schliemann excavated the ancient city of Troy.
谢里曼发掘出特洛伊古城。

excavation
音标：英 /ekskə'veɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /,ɛkskə'veʃən/
n. 挖掘；发掘
短语：deep excavation — 深挖[工]
短语：underground excavation — 地下挖掘
短语：excavation work — 挖土工程
短语：rock excavation — 岩石开挖，开采岩石
短语：excavation depth — 挖掘深度
短语：earth excavation — 挖土工程；土方开挖
例句：A second excavation, in 1985, lasted a year and was cut short for technical reasons.
第二次挖掘是在1985年，因为技术原因持续了一年就突然停止了。
例句：If he thinks I’m particular about excavation records, you should see him taking pictures!
如果他觉得我对挖掘纪录很挑剔，你应该看看他是怎么拍照的。
例句：They were genetically distinct from other humans, and an upper molar tooth (above) found at the same excavation hints that these people were similar to earlier species like Homo erectus.
丹尼索瓦人在基因上独特于其他人种，在同一次洞穴挖掘中发现的上臼齿暗示着，这些人种与早期人种如直立猿人相类似。

interrupt
音标：英 /ɪntə'rʌpt/  美 /'ɪntə'rʌpt/
v. 打断……讲话；打岔；暂时中断或中止
短语：interrupt handling — 中断处置
短语：external interrupt — 外部中断
短语：interrupt request — 中断请求
短语：interrupt controller — 中断控制器
例句：Will you stop interrupting me!
别打断我的话！
例句：Sorry to interrupt, but I need to ask you to come downstairs.
很抱歉打扰了，我得请你下楼来。
例句：My studies were interrupted by the war.
我的学业由于战争而中断。

acute
音标：英 /ə'kjuːt/  美 /ə'kjut/
adj. 深刻的；敏锐的；强烈的，剧烈的
短语：acute myocardial infarction — 急性心肌梗塞
短语：acute pancreatitis — 胰腺炎；急性胰腺炎
短语：acute toxicity — 急性毒性，急性中毒
短语：acute leukemia — 急性白血病
短语：severe acute respiratory syndrome — 严重急性呼吸系统综合症
短语：acute appendicitis — 急性阑尾炎
短语：acute phase — 急性期
短语：acute abdomen — [医]急腹症
短语：acute angle — 锐角
短语：acute disease — 急性病
短语：acute pain — 急性痛；剧烈的疼痛
短语：acute gastroenteritis — 急性胃肠炎
短语：acute bronchitis — 急性支气管炎
短语：acute infection — 急性感染；急性传染
短语：acute lymphocytic leukemia — 急性淋巴细胞白血病；急性淋巴细菌性白血病
短语：acute care — 急性照护；急症护理
短语：acute pyelonephritis — 急性肾盂肾炎
短语：acute gastritis — [医]急性胃炎
短语：acute tonsillitis — 急性扁桃体炎；急乳蛾
短语：acute exposure — [核]急性照射
例句：The housing shortage is more acute than first thought.
住房短缺情况比一开始想的要严重。
例句：Simon’s vague manner concealed an acute mind.
西蒙貌似蒙昧，其实头脑灵活。
例句：acute pain
剧痛

assume
音标：英 /ə'sjuːm/  美 /ə'sum/
v. 假定；设想
短语：assume responsibility — 承担责任
短语：assume liability — 承担责任
短语：subjective assume — 主观臆断
例句：I think we can safely assume (=  it is almost certain  ) that interest rates will go up again soon.
我想我们几乎可以肯定，利率很快会再次上调。
例句：When it got to midnight and Paul was still not back, I began to assume the worst (=  think that the worst possible thing had happened  ) .
到午夜时保罗还没回来，我就开始往最坏的地方想了。

regardless
音标：英 /rɪ'gɑːdlɪs/  美 /rɪ'ɡɑrdləs/
adv. 不管；不顾
短语：regardless of — 不顾，不管
例句：Despite her recent surgery she has been carrying on regardless.
尽管她最近动了手术，她却一直在不顾一切地继续工作。

regardless of
不管；不顾
例句：Every problem you have is your responsibility, regardless of who caused it.
不管是谁造成的，你都需要对你面对的每个问题负全责。
例句：The fields give high and stable yields regardless of climatic circumstances.
不管天气条件如何， 这块地总是保持稳产高产。
例句：The new tax laws were rammed through regardless of the opposition of the majority of the people.
不顾大多数人民的反对，新的税法强行通过了。

mat
音标：英 /mæt/  美 /mæt/
n. 席子；垫子
短语：on the mat — 受责备；受审问
短语：chopped strand mat — 短切毡
短语：glass mat — 玻璃席
短语：rubber mat — 橡胶垫
短语：floor mat — 地毯
短语：door mat — 门垫
短语：straw mat — 草席；蚕用草荐
短语：mouse mat — 鼠标垫
短语：bath mat — 浴室脚垫；浴室防滑垫
短语：place mat — 餐具垫
短语：earth mat — 接地网
例句：Wipe your feet on the mat.
在地垫上蹭蹭你的鞋底。

quilt
音标：英 /kwɪlt/  美 /kwɪlt/
n. 被子；棉被
短语：quilt cover — 被套，被罩
短语：patchwork quilt — 拼布床单；用小块布缝缀的被罩
例句：...an old patchwork quilt.
…一条旧的拼布被子。

beast
音标：英 /biːst/  美 /bist/
n. 野兽
短语：wild beast — n. 野兽
短语：beauty and the beast — 《美女与野兽》（动画片）
短语：a beast of — [口语]粗野；恶劣
短语：beast of burden — 驮兽（如马、驴等）
短语：beast of prey — 食肉兽，猛兽
短语：beauty and beast — 美女与野兽（电影名及电影主题曲）
例句：You beast! Let go!
你这畜生，放开我！

at most
至多；最多
例句：I do it for maybe an hour at most.
我或许在沙滩上最多呆一个钟头。

centimetre
音标：英 /'sentɪmiːtə/  美 /'sɛntɪmitɚ/
n. 厘米 (<美>centimeter)
例句：...a tiny fossil plant, only a few centimetres high.
…一块小小的植物化石，只有几厘米高。

sharpen
音标：英 /'ʃɑːp(ə)n/  美 /'ʃɑrpən/
v. （使）锋利；尖锐
短语：sharpen up — 使……更敏锐；认真思考
例句：Anne sharpened her pencil and got out her homework.
安妮把铅笔削尖，然后拿出家庭作业来。
